name: panic-attack-mcp
description: panic-attacker static analysis. Scans codebases for dangerous patterns, banned constructs, proof drift, and OWASP-class vulnerabilities across 49 languages.

tools.name: panic_attack_scan
tools.description: Run panic-attack assail on a path. Returns weak points across all 21 categories.

path.description: Absolute path to scan (file or directory)

tools.name: panic_attack_get_findings
tools.description: Retrieve cached findings for a previous scan by scan ID.

scan_id.description: Scan ID from a prior panic_attack_scan call

tools.name: panic_attack_get_severity
tools.description: Get severity distribution (info/low/medium/high/critical counts) for a scan.
